notes.title: Quality of Life & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Quality of life improvements[/h3]

When there are a bunch of items in front of you, then [b]heavy items are pulled first[/b]. This should help you utilize your maximum destruction potential.

Outdoor levels in arcade mode were slightly rebalanced so there is always a better ratio of ammo items vs buildings.

Inventory system received some upgrades too - Full inventory indicator was added, making it obvious when you filled up the inventory  as well as items don't overflow anymore, meaning no items jumping out of your hand into your face.

Pull speed control curve was slightly modified, making telekinesis control slightly easier when you are fully upgraded.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

- Hands sometimes disappeared - shouldn't happen anymore
- Tutorial 3 glass now breaks again
- Buildings are now destroyed more consistently (before even super heavy items could bounce on the first shot, now they will do proper damage)

notes.title: Biggest Update Yet
notes.notes:
Hey everyone we just released a new version of StressOut. This update brings new game mode, completely reimagined to fit our initial vision better - build the most chaotic relaxing experience that you can replay multiple times and is always somewhat different and always fun.

[previewyoutube=VBgZRigLCC0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Arcade mode[/h1]

Get through 39 procedurally generated levels, farm the gold and unlock powerful upgrades. We built a brand new upgrade system that sets the foundation for future expansion - more spells, more variety, more destruction.


[b]Win Rewards[/b]

Can you beat the developers? Look for [i]Shavorich[/i] and [i]Otiv[/i]  on leaderboards. Get to top of leaderboards to win a free VR game. Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/9pAqPvb]our Discord server[/url] to see the rules and other ways you can win 

Score is simply calculated by looking at how much time you have left in the last room times 10. So if you have 320.1s on the clock when you finish the run, you will get 3201 points.

[h2]Procedural levels[/h2]

A completely new system has been built from the ground up to allow us to generate all kinds of levels. 

Currently there are only a few archetype levels: 
[list]
[*] Shop - indoor small scale destruction
[*] Warehouse - Medium sized chaos 
[*] Outdoors - Full scale destruction
[*] Ceramics - Juicy and full of cash for upgrades
[/list]

Each of these archetype levels has tons of configurations that can spawn during arcade mode. There are even more configurations as you purchase special unlockable sections. Anyways there is a ton and it’s just going to get better.

[h2]What’s coming?[/h2]

We feel like arcade mode is currently in really early stages of its development so we are planning to extend it with new super powers and greater variety of levels. This should come relatively soon.

We are also thinking of building systems for community such as daily challenges, different variants of arcade mode (melee only anyone?)… Let us know what you would like.

[b]Asymmetric multiplayer[/b] we have an early version of asymmetric multiplayer (a mode where 1 player plays on flat screen and 1 in VR) version in the works and are looking for some testers. Let us know if you want to help.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Beta Update 3
notes.notes:
[h1]2 Bonus Levels[/h1]

Codename "WTF" levels, because they are nothing like the main game levels. Made purely to abuse the mechanics we built so far. Think no gravity, puzzles, explosions, wtf...?

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/Bonus_Levels.gif[/img]

[h1]Human Ragdolls[/h1]

We implemented the core of human ragdolls, but only added a few to the game so far. The idea is that later levels will be busier. Chapter 1 is only the intro, we don't want to overwhelm the new players.

The important part is, it works and we can use it. Now the question is, how to make the most epic scenarios out of it. Ideas?

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/virtualreality/comments/iz4u0z/we_had_telekinesis_and_humans_feels_satisfying/]See Video on Reddit[/url]

[h1]Explosive Crystals[/h1]

Who doesn't like explosions? The game is much richer with another fun mechanic - red explosive crystals. Throw them into a stack of boxes and enjoy that satisfying scene. The impact shrapnel will activate objects in the area to gain more time faster.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1143770/ss_7c52d3a73288b626d75a80f4468039d9f762a683.600x338.jpg?t=1599324548[/img]

[h1]Collectables[/h1]

There are currently 21 hidden objects in the levels. These collectables will tell you a bit about the world of StressOut and will unlock bonus levels.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/Collectables.gif[/img]

[h1]Music[/h1]

StressOut features adaptive music, meaning it will change as you do different things in the game. The main way to change the music is to destroy loads of things while playing.

We are in early stages of music so it will definitely change in the future, but we think we found a good foundation. The groovy funk just makes destroying more pleasurable.

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
One of the things we noticed, was that people didn't realize there are more upgrades, so they wouldn't look for them. Then they would finish the game with 5/21 upgrades and think that's it, while there was much more to the game. We updated the info panels to show your game progress.

We also added 3D messages when you pick up upgrades and collectables. We are experimenting with message system showing time counter and other things, but please let us know if you think it's too much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/ca8df6a0222ab97c5ddeaf8dad7c6b867781e938.png[/img]

[h1]Settings panel[/h1]
Before you could not really configure StressOut in any way. Now we give you some basic options, we will extend it as the time goes on.

Make sure to enable "Beauty" camera if you are recording footage ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/b57ea009fdfc429cbae81c0a1337543452014814.png[/img]

[h1]Loads of other upgrades[/h1]
- Save game reset
- Garage introduction chapter - a full new tutorial
- 100+ voice lines added
- New tools and weapons
- Updated upgrade visuals
- Split up "Pull Speed Control" into a separate upgrade (it's a late game mechanic, so it's probably best if you unlock it instead of just having it at the beginning)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/b5ae8dd7adb7d8dc96a73396c5ea875c36721474.png[/img]

If you would like to support us, the best way to do so right now is to spread the word and give us feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9pAqPvb]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Beta Update 2
notes.notes:
Over the course of last month we focused on improving experience for newer players. There are few smaller changes and improvements for existing players.

A huge amount of time was also spent getting the music team and voice over ready. StressOut will get [b]Adaptive Music[/b] as the time progresses. We are really satisfied with the team of 4 musicians and producers we got on board. Join Discord as we plan to share some samples soon!

[h2]Major improvement[/h2]

[list]
  [*][b]A secret section[/b] - can you find it ;)?[/*]
  [*]10 new models and items to interact with[/*]
  [*]New Practice level that comes after a tutorial[/*]
  [*]Sound system:[/*]
[/list]
 [olist]
    [*]50+ voice lines integrated[/*]
    [*]10+ new impact sound effects[/*]
    [*]Added better spatial awareness to loads of sounds[/*]
    [*]Overhauled watch voice over sound emitter[/*][/olist]


[h2]Smaller Improvements[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Increased max pickup distance - items can now be pulled from roughly 30% further.[/*]
  [*]Decreased minimum pickup distance (it should be possible to pull items that are on the floor just next to you)[/*]
  [*]When going to recording mode you can now just press [b]F1[/b] instead of needing to press [b]F1[/b] (enable screen camera) then [b]1[/b] (select FPS camera)[/*]
  [*]Improved lift UI[/*]
  [*]Made rating 1,2,3 easier (loads of people struggled with Level 1 so it was obviously too hard)[/*]
  [*]Prevent shooting when item would hit the wall immediately after launch. This was mainly done so we can build proper user intrefaces. For example, if you wanted to interact with lift interface and extended your index finger it would shoot pressing wrong buttons. Now it won't shoot until the path is clear.[/*]
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Counter works correctly[/*]
[*]5+ other smaller bugfixes that probably nobody noticed yet :D[/*]
[*]Sometimes items stay stuck in the hand and you cannot get them out until you restart the game.[/*][/list]

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]

[list][*]HTC teleportation is still working badly[/*][/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We just started the work on two new major features:

[list]
[*]Bringing human ragdolls into the game (so you can throw people around with telekinesis)[/*][*]Collectibles (hidden objects, that will give you achievements and maybe some other stuff in the future)[/*]
[/list]

But don't worry, that's not all, we have 5 new levels in the pipeline as well that should come out with Early Access release that we are hoping to do in roughly 2 months.

You can read more about [url=https://stressout.net/updates/beta-3]the next update here[/url] and about the [url=https://stressout.net/future-plans]future plans here[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - Beta Update 1
notes.notes:
[h2]First Week of Beta[/h2]
Thank you all for helping us test StressOut. We have received some invaluable feedback and we worked on it! First update is mostly focused on making improvements and bug fixes to the core of the game.
[h2]Physics Reworked[/h2]
Several people noted that some items are over powered when you hold them in the hand. The reason for this is the fact that items were fixed to your hands when you picked them up, now the items are attached using a "spring". Attaching the items via the spring gives us multiple benefits:
[list][*]1. Items will not be moved around by unstoppable force so they will react properly to environment[/*][*]2. Adjusting the spring strength gives us the ability to give weight to the items (really similar to Half Life Alyx)[/*][/list]
We also added physics to several game objects as you can see at the end of the gif below:

[url=https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/beta-1.mp4.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/4de4566d61a5ed745e07b339479f930f12491e25.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Score System Update[/h2]
So far the game would finish after you activated [b]all items[/b]. Looking for last few items at the end can be really annoying, so we decided to change this and finish the game after you reach rank 4. [b]Time left when achiving the rank 4 will be converted to extra score points.[/b]

To achieve a specific rank you have to:
[list][*][b]Rank 1[/b] - Activate [b]50%[/b] of the items[/*][*][b]Rank 2[/b] - Activate [b]70%[/b] of the items[/*][*][b]Rank 3[/b] - Activate [b]80%[/b] of the items[/*][*][b]Rank 4[/b] - Activate [b]90%[/b] of the items[/*][/list][h2]Other improvements:[/h2][list][*]Hands now colour items on touch[/*][*]Prevent teleporting when hand is inside the wall[/*][*]Improved calculation that determines whether the glass should break or not[/*][*]Increased spell sizes:[/*][*][list][*]Level 1: 4 → 13 items[/*][*]Level 2: 13 → 21 items[/*][*]Level 3: 21 → 29 items[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[url=https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/beta-2.mp4.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/4de4566d61a5ed745e07b339479f930f12491e25.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*]Staff room now opens after completing level 5[/*][*]Leaderboards long names should be properly shown[/*][*]Leaderboards should correctly show players around your rank[/*][*]Small Spell Cast fix where it would trigger sound and visual effects even if it wasn't casted[/*][*]Reduced glass volume[/*][*]Disable teleportation during level loading (this caused some players to start outside of a level)[/*][/list][h2]Known bugs[/h2][list][*]HTC Vive teleportation has to be reworked (we are aiming to fix this before end of the month)[/*][*]Voice lines are triggering when they are not supposed to (reworked voice line system is going to replace this one soon and it should get fixed at that point, until then, sorry!)[/*][/list]
Especially thanks to all the beta testers who provided feedback 💙: @Kcam99, @Aero, @SteveZero, @PatchPatch, @SammyJspodge, @VirtuallyHealthy, @Phillip (Zilchmasta), @Ms. Switch, @tommy, @Wrarv, @poopendecken.

If you haven't signed up for [url=https://stressout.net/beta]beta[/url] yet, [url=https://stressout.net/beta]please do it here[/url], we would love your feedback.
